(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))

    (adjacent
      (block ShadowRenderer
        (port :in Receipt)

        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block LocalRenderer
        (port :in Event :as evt)
        (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
      (block EdgeBilling
        (port :in Command)

        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))

        (port :out Request)

                    (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
                    (port :out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))))))

        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block EdgeCache

                  (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))

                  (port :in Receipt :as req)

                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))

                  (port :out Command)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))))
        (level

              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))
